title: Validate Before Commit: reproducibility artifact (code and protocols)
description: Code, protocols and reproducibility guide for the paper 'Candidate Comparability Before Promotion: Conditional Validation in Adaptive Network Intrusion Detection' (framework and gate family: Validate Before Commit). The artifact contains: the progressive-drift readaptation experiment runner; the promotion-policy family, including VBC-SG; preregistered controls for preprocessing ownership and candidate evidence; the source-row-disjoint B2 and B1 blocks preserved as historical evidence; the final preregistered exact-cleaned-feature-group-disjoint B2 and B1 sensitivity (seeds 7001-7030 and 8001-8030), including the forensic exact-feature-overlap audit, frozen configs, checkpoints and analysis outputs; all scripts that regenerate every table and figure; sealed result manifests; and a claims audit that verifies manuscript numbers against generated artifacts. The final sensitivity retains a positive resolved 512-to-2,000 effect in all three benchmarks but finds material benefit in only two, and the policy interpretation is partially robust. Datasets (CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15, ToN-IoT) are public and not redistributed.
